scientific_limitation: No corresponding assertion for other Reed–Muller lengths, code families, or access-cost optimality.
statement_scope: Binary RM_2(1,4), length 16, all six-multiset requests for stored coordinates under disjoint singleton/triple recovery. Seven identical requests are impossible.
title: Sharp six-request all-symbol batch capacity of the binary length-16 first-order Reed–Muller code
verification: The six-request assertion has a finite exhaustive witness certificate for 54,264 multisets; expert or formal-proof attestations are not asserted.
